comment: Published releases that predate release-manifest.json. An entry matters
only while that version is the CURRENT release (the daily rescan covers
the current release only); it is then rescanned from this inventory (audit F12). Each lists the exact published digests -
never tags. v0.1.0 was built by the pre-remediation pipeline; its
digests were resolved once (Sep 8 2026) and pinned. Keep the entry
while the version is supported; a newer release only stops it being scanned.
